title: Why site November 5 was targeted
place_text: Site November 5, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: why November 5, the closest to a town, the closest to the launch control facility and the least amount of travel time for all other nine missiles?

plain: In 1977, at a nuclear missile launch site called November 5 in the missile field of Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, something chose that site on purpose, according to Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was there and was abducted. He asks why November 5 in particular, and answers that it was the closest to a town, the closest to the launch control center, and the quickest to reach from the other nine missiles, which to him suggests whoever came knew the layout of the base.
